user.title: Connect to a Cadence server
user.description: Home Assistant follows every device of this server: devices added, renamed or deleted there show up here.

data_description.url: The server's https address, e.g. https://cadence.example.com.
data_description.token: A token with the ha scope: cadence-server admin token create --name home-assistant --scope ha.

reauth_confirm.title: New token for {server}
reauth_confirm.description: The server refused the token: it was deleted. Create a new one with the ha scope.

reconfigure.title: Change the Cadence server
reconfigure.description: Leave the token empty to keep the one you gave before, while the host stays the same.

error.invalid_url: Enter the server's https URL, without a login, query or fragment.
error.insufficient_scope: The token has no ha scope.
error.token_too_broad: The token can do more than Home Assistant needs: create one with the ha scope alone.
error.token_required: Give the token again: the stored one is never sent to another host.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the server, or its certificate is not trusted.

abort.already_configured: This server is already set up.

say.name: Say
say.description: Speaks a text on Cadence speakers with the server's text-to-speech.

language.name: Language
language.description: The language to speak in; without one, the server's default.

set_timer.name: Set timer
set_timer.description: Starts a timer on Cadence speakers. Alarms are never set from Home Assistant.

device_id.name: Speakers
device_id.description: The Cadence devices that ring the timer.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long, from 1 second to 24 hours.

set_reminder.name: Set reminder
set_reminder.description: Sets a reminder on Cadence speakers, which say its text when it rings. Give a time (with a date or days) or a number of minutes.

device_id.name: Speakers
device_id.description: The Cadence devices that ring the reminder.

text.name: Label
text.description: What to remind of, 1 to 80 characters.

time.name: Time
time.description: When it rings; without a date or days, at its next such time.

days.name: Days
days.description: The weekdays it rings on, every week.

in_minutes.name: In minutes
in_minutes.description: Or rings once in this many minutes, instead of a time.

invalid_auth.message: The Cadence server refused the token.

no_target.message: Pick a Cadence speaker or its media player.

unknown_target.message: {target} is not a Cadence speaker this server knows.

not_loaded.message: The Cadence server of {target} is not set up right now.

enqueue_unsupported.message: A Cadence speaker has no queue: it can only play the media now.

media_unsupported.message: A Cadence speaker plays only http and https addresses up to 2047 characters.

no_catalog.message: {target} has no screen to browse the catalog on.

no_catalog_session.message: No catalog title is playing on {target}.

not_a_group_member.message: {entity} is not a Cadence speaker of the same server as {target}, so it cannot join its group.

stereo_pair.message: {target} is in a stereo pair: a pair takes no other speaker.

unknown_device.message: A speaker to group with {target} is not known to the server.

invalid_choice.message: The playing title on {target} does not offer that choice.

unknown_ref.message: The item is no longer in the catalog.

unplayable.message: No source of the catalog can play this item.

sign_in_required.message: The catalog's source needs a sign-in again.

unavailable.message: The catalog's source did not answer for {target}.

tts_unconfigured.message: The Cadence server has no text-to-speech set up, so {target} cannot speak.

superseded.message: A newer session or announcement replaced this one on {target}.

announce_invalid.message: The server refused the text or its language for {target}.

timer_duration.message: A Cadence timer runs whole seconds, from 1 second to 24 hours.

reminder_when.message: Give a reminder either a time (with a date or days, not both) or a number of minutes.
